title: PNC FINANCIAL SERVICES GROUP, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: PNC Financial Services Group filed an 8-K disclosing results of its April 22, 2026 annual shareholder meeting. Shareholders approved the 2026 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan authorizing 28,000,000 new shares for equity awards, elected 13 director nominees, ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor for 2026, and approved executive compensation on an advisory basis. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Shareholders approved The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. 2026 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan on April 22, 2026
The Plan authorizes 28,000,000 shares plus any remaining unused shares from the 2016 predecessor plan
All 13 director nominees were elected with approval ratings ranging from 94.30% to 99.64%
PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP was ratified as independent auditor for 2026 (98.17% for, 1.83% against)
Advisory say-on-pay vote passed with 93.56% approval (20,469,427 votes against)
Total eligible votes at record were 403,516,196 shares
